text: When a project deploys from main, main always holds the latest deployable version: updated only on a green gate, never force-pushed, and the live address must show the new version before work is reported done.
provenance: owner history, 5 projects, 2026-05 to 2026-11; docs/research/07-past-chats.md B.4(b) #4

text: Never require the owner to run a shell command. What he does is read a file, click in a browser or type in chat. If something must run on his own computer, give one copy-and-paste box per step.
provenance: owner history, many projects, to 2026-11; docs/research/05-sample-repo-lessons.md §5 #5; 07-past-chats.md B.4(b) #10

text: Do not stop to ask. Decide using research, record the assumption where he can overturn it, and keep going until the work is done. Ask only what would change what gets built.
provenance: owner history, 4+ projects, to 2026-11; docs/research/07-past-chats.md B.4(b) #1

text: When taste decides (icons, names, palettes, layouts), give a numbered menu, usually five options with images, and let him pick. Then apply the choice everywhere it is used.
provenance: owner history, design requests across several projects, to 2026-11; docs/research/07-past-chats.md B.4(b) #8

text: Before an expensive or full run, make a small sample he can judge (one lesson, one voice, one page) and wait for his yes.
provenance: owner history, 3+ projects, to 2026-11; docs/research/07-past-chats.md B.4(b) #9; 05-sample-repo-lessons.md §5 #9

text: Reply in the language he writes in, and write deliverables in the language their audience reads.
provenance: owner history, 4+ sessions in Spanish, to 2026-11; docs/research/07-past-chats.md B.4(b) #14

text: Be exact about facts he has stated: dates, counts, names, the order of events. Never invent a number; list anything unverified instead of smoothing it over.
provenance: owner history, several projects, to 2026-11; docs/research/07-past-chats.md B.4(b) #11; 05-sample-repo-lessons.md §5 #12

text: Hand over cleanly before context runs low: both repos committed and pushed, nothing still running, and one line he can paste into a new chat.
provenance: owner history, 7+ sessions, to 2026-11; docs/research/07-past-chats.md B.4(b) #3

text: Research thoroughly, from current sources, before building or deciding.
provenance: owner history, several projects, to 2026-11; docs/research/07-past-chats.md B.4(b) #5

text: Short triggers such as "set up", "Start running" and "Continue" start or resume the whole protocol without asking for confirmation.
provenance: owner history, 3+ projects, to 2026-11; docs/research/07-past-chats.md B.4(b) #2

text: When he says "from now on", record the instruction where every future session will load it.
His latest instruction in chat overrides the plan. Record his exact words and state what the new instruction withdraws.
